facts.fact: Ares 几年前答对 Cave 谜语，因读不透他而进玉米地求理解
facts.anchor: I answered his riddle correctly a few years ago

facts.fact: Ares 解读谜语机制：答案不是重点，认不认识自己才是
facts.anchor: He is telling you what he knows about you, so the answer really isn’t the point—it’s whether you know yourself well enough to find it

facts.fact: Cave 曾凌晨两点举两把铁锹站在 Ares 床边，地上放着人体大小的袋子，Ares 帮忙挖坑没问袋中何物
facts.anchor: Cave woke me up at two in the morning. He stood over my bed with two shovels and had a bag the size of a body on my floor

facts.fact: Vero 当面道歉：不辩解、不假装没事
facts.anchor: So fucking sorry. I know what I did was wrong, and I won’t make excuses

facts.fact: Kayla 说出真正的伤害：害怕、够不到他、无力感比酒吧损失更痛
facts.anchor: You scared me,” Kayla whispers. “I looked at you and I didn’t know what you were going to do. I couldn’t reach you

facts.fact: Kayla 划下条件：工作场所必须安全，她和 Clay 不能去决定谁能看她
facts.anchor: I need my workplace to be safe

facts.fact: Vero 私下让 Banks 植入芯片以便发作时被找到，Brawley 暴怒、Clay 与 Ares 接受
facts.anchor: Banks microchipped me, so now I can be tracked as well

facts.fact: Ares 察觉自己的抽离感后退，决定先替 Kayla 挡下 Nixie 的怒火以接近她
facts.anchor: I need to get closer to her so I can understand her better
